toa_obtain_divine_rune_pouch.how: Stitch a thread of Elidinis (Tombs of Amascut reward) to a rune pouch (75 Crafting).

toa_obtain_keris_amascut.how: Combine a keris partisan (Beneath Cursed Sands; more from Selim, 60,000 coins) with a jewel of Amascut (Tombs of Amascut chest, 1/50 to 3/50).

toa_obtain_keris_breaching.how: Attach the breach of the scarab (Tombs of Amascut reward) to a keris partisan.

toa_obtain_keris_corruption.how: Attach the eye of the corruptor (Tombs of Amascut reward) to a keris partisan.

toa_obtain_keris_sun.how: Attach the jewel of the sun (Tombs of Amascut reward) to a keris partisan.

toa_obtain_warden_pet.how: Pet from the Tombs of Amascut reward chest.

tob_equip_justiciar_faceguard.how: Theatre of Blood unique, from the monumental chest in Verzik's vault.

tob_equip_justiciar_legguards.how: Theatre of Blood unique, from the monumental chest in Verzik's vault.

tob_mix_bastion_potion.how: Mix at 80 Herblore: cadantine + vial of blood, then add a wine of Zamorak (Theatre of Blood supply potion).

tob_obtain_holy_kit.how: Tertiary reward from finishing Hard Mode Theatre of Blood.

tob_obtain_pet.how: Pet from the Theatre of Blood monumental chest; the rate depends on your performance in the raid.

tob_obtain_sanguine_dust.how: Tertiary reward from finishing Hard Mode Theatre of Blood.

tob_obtain_sanguine_kit.how: Tertiary reward from finishing Hard Mode Theatre of Blood.

vorkath_equip_avas_assembler.how: Take Vorkath's head (Vorkath, guaranteed on your 50th kill), 75 mithril arrows and Ava's accumulator to Ava in Draynor Manor.

yama_obtain_oathplate.how: Dropped by Yama, any Oathplate piece.

yama_obtain_pet.how: Yama's pet, on its own roll after the loot.

yama_obtain_sigil_bottom.how: Defeat Yama after signing the Contract of Glyphic Attenuation.

yama_obtain_sigil_left.how: Defeat Yama after signing the Contract of Sensory Clouding.

yama_obtain_sigil_middle.how: Defeat Yama after signing the Contract of Bloodied Blows.

yama_obtain_sigil_right.how: Defeat Yama after signing the Contract of Divine Severance.

yama_obtain_sigil_top.how: Defeat Yama after signing the Contract of Forfeit Breath.
